data.one_liner: Library for parsing, creating, and manipulating GeoJSON data per RFC 7946
data.what_it_does: geojson_vi provides classes for all GeoJSON geometry types, features, and collections, allowing developers to parse from maps or JSON, construct new objects, and perform operations like searching and bbox calculations. It fully supports null geometry values and offers utility methods for point containment and optimal point placement.
use_when: You need to read or write GeoJSON files in a Dart/Flutter app
You want to manipulate GeoJSON features programmatically (create, update, delete)
You need to handle null geometry values according to the spec
You require utility methods for geometry calculations such as bbox or point containment
avoid_when: You only need to display GeoJSON on a map widget (use a mapping package instead)
You need high-performance spatial queries on large datasets (consider a dedicated spatial database)
strengths: Comprehensive support for all GeoJSON geometry types
Built-in handling of null geometry values per RFC 7946
Simple, declarative API for creating and manipulating features
Utility methods for bbox, nearest feature, and point containment
weaknesses: No built-in map rendering or UI components
No performance benchmarks for large datasets
Limited to GeoJSON; does not integrate with other spatial formats
